makemeahanzi.definition: mud, earth, clay; plaster, paste

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 泥 names mud, a mix of earth and water.
尼 (ní) gives the sound — an exact match with 泥.

makemeahanzi.definition: to fix, to mend, to patch, to restore

characterDeckComponents.note: 衤 (cloth) — 补 means to mend or patch clothing.
卜 (bǔ) gives the sound — an exact match with 补.

meanings: (fig.) (of a person) choked up with anxiety or stress

makemeahanzi.definition: wall; to stop, to prevent, to block

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 堵 relates to blocking something, like a wall of earth.
者 (zhě) gives a sound only distantly related to dǔ today, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to fish with a hook and line

makemeahanzi.definition: fishhook; to fish, to lure

etymology.hint: A metal 钅 hook 勺; 勺 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) shows the material of the fishing hook.
勺 depicts a small curved shape, echoed in the curve of a fishing hook.

makemeahanzi.definition: petal, flower, leaf; brave, heroic; English

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 英 originally meant 'flower, blossom,' later borrowed for 'outstanding, hero' and to write 'England, English.'
央 (yāng) gives a sound hint — 英 is pronounced yīng, sharing the initial consonant and a nasal final, though the vowel has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: not, negative

etymology.hint: Two arrows 丨 pulled across a bow

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (a bow) — the curved frame.
丨 (a straight line), shown twice — arrows or a bowstring pulled tight across it; the character is mostly used today in transliteration.

makemeahanzi.definition: dusk, nightfall, twilight, dark; to faint, to lose consciousness

etymology.hint: Th sun 日 setting behind a village 氏

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) at the bottom shows the sun low in the sky.
氏 above suggests the sun dipping out of sight, giving 昏 its meaning 'dusk, growing dark.'

meanings: (bound form) to put into effect (regulations etc)

makemeahanzi.definition: to grant, to bestow; to act; surname
to pick, to pluck, to select, to take

etymology.hint: To pick 扌 a fruit off a branch 啇

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — picking fruit is done by hand.
啇 (root of 蒂, a fruit's stem) contributes to the character's form, naming what the fruit is picked from.

makemeahanzi.definition: to condole, to mourn, to pity; to hang
simple, succinct, terse; a letter

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 简 originally referred to bamboo strips used for writing
间 (jiān) gives a sound close to 简's reading jiǎn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to scold; to yawn; the sound of someone laughing (when repeated)

characterDeckComponents.note: Mouth — sounds like scolding, yawning, or laughing come from the mouth.
Gives the sound kě, related to ā but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: lips

characterDeckComponents.note: Mouth — lips surround the mouth.
Gives the sound chén, related to chún but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: prosperous, plentiful, abundant
well, mine shaft, pit

characterDeckComponents.note: 井 is a simplified picture of a wooden frame built around the mouth of a well, seen from above.

makemeahanzi.definition: to kill; to die a violent death

characterDeckComponents.note: 死 (death) — 毙 relates directly to dying.
比 (bǐ) gives a sound close to bì, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to send; to present, to deliver; to cause; consequence

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (an action/to strike) — ties to 致's sense of bringing about or causing an effect
至 (zhì) gives the sound — 致 is also pronounced zhì, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to arrest, to detain; to deposit, to pledge; mortgage

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — holding something as a pledge.
Gives the sound jiǎ, related to yā but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: Chinese people; Chinese language

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 漢; the Han 𦰩 river 氵

characterDeckComponents.note: 汉 is a simplified form of 漢, pairing the water radical 氵 with a component that named the river valley tied to the Han dynasty and Han Chinese identity.

meanings: used for its phonetic value in writing foreign words

makemeahanzi.definition: but, how; to bear, to stand, to endure

etymology.hint: A man 大 with spirit 示

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (a person, from the pictograph of a standing figure) forms the main part of the character.
示 (spirit, altar) suggests a person before the spirits, expressing helplessness, giving 奈 its meaning 'how, what can be done' as in 无奈 (helpless).

makemeahanzi.definition: child, boy; servant boy; virgin

etymology.hint: A child standing 立 in the village 里

characterDeckComponents.note: 立 (standing) — a small figure standing upright.
里 here representing a village or settlement, together giving 童 its meaning 'child.'

meanings: to stray from the intended line

makemeahanzi.definition: slanting, inclined; prejudiced

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 偏 describes a person's position or attitude leaning to one side.
扁 (biǎn) gives a sound close to piān, sharing the same kind of initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: accidentally, coincidently; mate, image, idol

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 偶 originally described a wooden figure or idol shaped like a person, later extending to 'a pair' and 'by chance.'
禺 (yú) gives a sound distantly related to 偶's reading ǒu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: older brother; father's elder brother; sir, sire, count

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 伯 names a male relative, a person in the family.
白 (bái) gives the sound — close to bó, sharing the same initial and a similar rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to offer, to present; to show, to display

characterDeckComponents.note: 犬 (dog) — 献 originally referred to offering a dog in sacrifice, extended to mean 'to offer, present.'
南 (nán) gives a sound distantly related to xiàn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: leaf, page; surname
fair, equitable; public; duke

etymology.hint: To divide 八 what is private 厶

characterDeckComponents.note: 八 here depicts something splitting apart or being divided.
厶 is an old form meaning 'private' or 'one's own' — 公 shows dividing up private property to share it fairly, giving rise to the meaning 'public' or 'fair.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to eat seeds; to reproach; loquacious

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) marks 嗑 as an action done with the mouth — cracking seeds with the teeth.
盍 (hé) has diverged substantially in sound from kē, leaving no clear connection in modern Mandarin.

meanings: to comply with or listen to sb

makemeahanzi.definition: to rely on; to consent, to obey; according to

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 依 relates to a person relying or leaning on something
衣 (yī) gives the sound — 依 is also pronounced yī, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to help, to relieve, to take pity on

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart/mind) — the heart radical, marking the character as related to emotions or mental states.
血 (xuè) gives a sound close to 恤's reading xù, sharing the same initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drive, to ride, to sail; carriage, cart

characterDeckComponents.note: 马 (horse) shows 驾 relates to driving or controlling an animal or vehicle.
加 (jiā) gives a sound close to jià, differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: pure, clean; simple, genuine

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (silk/thread) — 纯 originally described unmixed, undyed silk thread, extending to 'pure, unmixed.'
屯 (tún) gives a sound distantly related to chún, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to wear; to split, to crack

etymology.hint: To put on 扌 fur 皮; 皮 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — draping a garment over the shoulders is done with the hands.
皮 (fur, skin) contributes to the character's form, naming what early garments were made of.

makemeahanzi.definition: dregs, sediment; refuse, slag

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 渣 (dregs, residue) is what's left over from a liquid.
查 (chá) gives a sound distantly related to zhā, sharing the same final but having drifted apart in initial consonant over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: hat, cap

characterDeckComponents.note: Cloth/towel — hats are made of cloth.
Gives the sound mào, matching the character's reading.

meanings: Korea from the fall of the Joseon dynasty in 1897
Korea, esp. South Korea 大韓民國|大韩民国

makemeahanzi.definition: Korea, especially South Korea; surname
beautiful, glamorous, sexy, voluptuous

etymology.hint: Lush 丰 and sexy 色

characterDeckComponents.note: 丰 (lush, abundant) suggests something rich and full.
色 (color, appearance) sits beside it — lush abundance and striking appearance together give 艳 its meaning 'gorgeous, colorful.'

makemeahanzi.definition: business, profession; to study, to work
friend, companion; fraternity

etymology.hint: Two hands 又 joined, representing friendship; 又 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (hand), shown twice and joined together — two hands clasped in friendship gave 友 its meaning 'friend.'

makemeahanzi.definition: state, condition; shape, appearance, form; certificate

characterDeckComponents.note: 犬 (dog) — an old, now-opaque link behind 状's meaning 'form, shape, condition'
丬 (qiáng) gives a loose sound connection to 状's reading zhuàng

makemeahanzi.definition: article, good, product; commodity; quality, character

etymology.hint: Something that everyone is talking 口 about

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth), stacked three times — many mouths talking about or judging something, the source of 品's meaning 'product, item; quality, rank.'

makemeahanzi.definition: scar, mark; vestige, trace

characterDeckComponents.note: 疒 (sickness) — a scar is a mark left by an injury or illness.
艮 (gèn) gives a sound close in rhyme to hén, though the initial consonant has drifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: fruit, nut; result

etymology.hint: Fruit 田 growing on a tree 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 田 (here representing round fruit, not its usual meaning 'field') — 果 pictures fruit hanging from branches.
木 (tree) — fruit growing on a tree gave 果 its meaning 'fruit' and, more broadly, 'result.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to restrict, to prohibit, to forbid; to endure

characterDeckComponents.note: 示 (altar) — 禁 relates to sacred restrictions observed near an altar.
林 (lín) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading jìn has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: glory, honor; to flourish, to prosper

etymology.hint: Grass 艹 and trees 木 flourishing in a garden 冖

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass) forms the top of the character.
木 (tree), sheltered beneath a covering, together depict plants flourishing, giving 荣 its meaning 'glory, prosperity.'

makemeahanzi.definition: multitude, crowd; masses, public

etymology.hint: Three people 人 representing a crowd

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 (person), tripled — three people together depict a crowd, giving 众 its meaning 'many, multitude.'

makemeahanzi.definition: foolish, stupid, rash; vulgar

etymology.hint: To talk 日 like a fish 鱼

characterDeckComponents.note: 鱼 (fish) forms the top of the character.
日, placed beneath the fish, was linked to the idea of speaking crudely or bluntly, giving 鲁 its meaning 'rash, uncouth.'

makemeahanzi.definition: good, auspicious; beautiful; delightful

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) shows 佳 describes a positive quality, often applied to people or things.
圭 (guī) gives a sound distantly related to jiā, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: all, every, everybody
cable, rope; rules, laws; to demand, to exact; to search, to inquire

etymology.hint: A rope 糸 hanging from the ceiling 冖

characterDeckComponents.note: 糸 (thread) — thick strands twisted into a rope
冖 (a covering) — the ceiling or beam the rope hangs from
